Block.description: A timed slice of a call: these scenes (or a label like "Warm-up"), from start for minutes.
Block.title: Block

CallContent.description: What a call is. Staff edit a working copy; cast and crew see the copy as of the last publish.
CallContent.title: CallContent

CheckIn.description: One person on one tech or performance night (or a rehearsal they said they'd be late to).
CheckIn.title: CheckIn

DateConflict.description: An answer for one date. It wins over a weekly rule for that date.
DateConflict.title: DateConflict

InvitePreview.description: What the sign-in page shows for an invite link, before anyone signs in.
InvitePreview.title: InvitePreview

Me.description: What the signed-in user sees on their home page.
Me.title: Me

RehearsalSlot.description: A usual rehearsal night: weekday 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday, times as HH:MM in the show's timezone.
RehearsalSlot.title: RehearsalSlot

SaveConflictsBody.description: Saves several answers at once, as the guided setup does at the end.
SaveConflictsBody.title: SaveConflictsBody

TechCallsBody.description: Makes an everyone-called call for each tech and performance night that doesn't have one.
TechCallsBody.title: TechCallsBody

Warning.description: Someone a block or call needs who can't make all of it.
Warning.title: Warning

WeeklyConflict.description: A usual-week rule, e.g. "never Tuesdays" or "late on Wednesdays". One per weekday.
WeeklyConflict.title: WeeklyConflict
